0022600180.text: The Cavaliers (4-3, 2nd in the Central, 2 games back, 5th in the East) enter on a one-game losing streak and are 1-2 on the road, without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness). The Oklahoma City Thunder (5-2, 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, 5th in the West) are on a one-game win streak and 3-0 at home, but are missing Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee). Cleveland trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 117-112 loss in Cleveland on November 2, and it lost both meetings in 2025-26.
